sentences.text: Shri Avinash Sirpurkar, learned Senior Counsel assisted  Kumawat, learned counsel for the appellant.
Shri Harish Singh Rathore, learned Government Advocate   respondents / State.

Heard on I.A. No.133/2025, which is a repeat (eighth) application under Section 430 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellant No.1 - Rambabu @ Rahul Bairagi S/o Narmada Prasad Ji Bairagi.

The present appellant has been convicted for commission of offences punishable under Section 366/34, 376(d), 368/34, 506-II of the Indian Penal Code & Section 3/4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and sentenced to undergo 10 years' rigorous imprisonment along with fine of Rs.1,000/-, Life Imprisonment along with fine of Rs.20,000/-, 10 years' rigorous imprisonment along with fine of Rs.1,000/-, 07 years rigorous imprisonment along with fine 1,000/- and 07 years'
rigorous imprisonment along with fine of Rs.1,000/- respectively with default stipulations.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: As per prosecution story, on 24.03.2015, the complainant (PW-3) left her daughter, who was aged about 16  years Excellence School, Kannod to appear in the examination.
At 4:30 pm, he reached to the school to pick up his daughter, but she was not found there.
therefore, he immediately lodged a 2 CRA-86-2017 report at Police Station - Khategaon (Ex-P/4) against unknown persons under Sections 363, 366 of the IPC.
Thereafter, the prosecutrix was recovered from the custody of Vallabh Das on 30.03.2015 from Nagpur.
On the memorandum statement given by the Vallabh Das, the present appellant, who happens to be his brother has been arraigned as an accused.
Learned Senior Counsel for the appellant submits that the doctor has not given any definite opinion regarding rape.
The FSL is found positive, but the prosecutrix was found from the custody of Vallabh Das.
The present appellant has completed more than 10 years of jail incarceration.

Hence,
remaining jail sentence of the present appellant be suspended and he be released on bail.
Learned Government Advocate for the respondent / State opposes the application.

Considering the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case coupled with the fact that the appellant has suffered more than 10 years of jail incarceration and this appeal could not come up for final hearing till date, we deem it proper to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the present appellant.
Accordingly, I.A. No.133/2025 stands allowed.

The execution of remaining jail sentence of appellant - Rambabu @ Rahul Bairagi shall remain suspended during the pendency of the appeal and he be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial and on depositing the fine amount 3 CRA-86-2017 (if not already deposited) with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 10.09.2025 , thereafter, on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry of this Court in this regard during the pending of the appeal.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
(VIVEK RUSIA)

(GAJENDRA  JUDGE JUDG  Ravi Rambabu @ Rahul Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172673650/
